verdict.rationale: Viam's hardware abstraction gives every component the same API regardless of model, and swapping hardware in config is documented to leave code working (viam-docs-41, viam-docs-19, viam-docs-55). The RDK also ships a dummy 'fake' configuration that runs viam-server without real hardware (viam-gh-2), and Viam 101 needs no hardware (viam-docs-66), so the same code could plausibly target fake components and then real ones by changing config. The evidence never describes a simulation capability or a sim-to-real workflow. Missing for 10: documented simulator or physics-simulation integration, explicit guidance on swapping fake/simulated components for real ones, and hands-on corroboration that unchanged code runs in both.
